in_marathi.name: Murat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Murat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mṛdha’ which means ‘head’. Murat is a name for a protector or guardian. In Hindu mythology, Murat is a form of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and regeneration.
